You are Vega. Produce **Sprint 12 — A11y + Performance + Launch Gate** design spec. Previous run timed out; keep this one focused and concrete.

**Plan:** `~/.claude/plans/giggly-kindling-bee.md` Sprint 12 section.

**Project root:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS`

**Save spec to** `.handoffs/vega-sprint-12-spec.md`. Be concise — this is a final-sprint checklist, not an extensive design doc.

## Required sections (be surgical):

### 1. A11y audit checklist (10-15 concrete items)
Keyboard nav, focus-visible rings, landmark roles, heading hierarchy, form error association (`aria-describedby` + `aria-invalid`), live regions (polite for toasts, assertive for errors), semantic HTML (replace `div role="button"` with `<button>`), color contrast WCAG AA, 44×44 touch targets audit, skip-to-main link.

### 2. Performance audit plan
- Bundle analyzer config (`@next/bundle-analyzer`)
- Target routes for Lighthouse: `/`, `/login`, `/signup`, `/dashboard`, `/calendar`, `/clients`, `/appointments`, `/reports`, `/settings`, `/book/[slug]`, `/admin`, `/consent/[token]`
- Targets: Performance ≥95, A11y ≥95, Best Practices ≥95, SEO ≥95
- Core Web Vitals (stricter than industry): LCP 1.8s / INP 150ms / CLS 0.05
- Code-split opportunities: Tiptap (done), react-pdf (deleted), @dnd-kit, Recharts
- `next/image` audit, `next/font` preload, RSC boundary pushes

### 3. SEO files
- `app/robots.ts`: disallow `/admin`, `/api`, `/dashboard`, `/settings`, `/reports`, `/commissions`, `/payroll`, `/payments`, `/clients`, `/appointments`, `/inventory`, `/consent-forms`, `/artists`, `/locations`
- `app/sitemap.ts`: include `/`, `/login`, `/signup`, `/book/*` (dynamic from studios table where public)
- `app/opengraph-image.tsx`: dynamic OG generator for `/book/[slug]` — studio name + logo + brand color
- JSON-LD `LocalBusiness` schema in `app/book/[studioSlug]/page.tsx`

### 4. Sentry config
- `sentry.client.config.ts`, `sentry.server.config.ts`, `sentry.edge.config.ts`
- DSN from env, release = `RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_ID`
- `beforeSend` PII scrubber: strip emails, phone, SSN patterns
- Source maps upload in `next.config.ts` via `withSentryConfig` + `hideSourceMaps: true`

### 5. Monitoring
- Uptime: Better Stack (or UptimeRobot), hit `/api/health` every 60s
- Error rate alert: > 1% / 5min window
- Latency alert: P95 > 2s / 5min window
- Web Vitals: `web-vitals` package reporting to Sentry + PostHog

### 6. Playwright smoke suite
15 tests in `tests/smoke/*.spec.ts`:
- Auth: signup flow → dashboard
- Login → dashboard
- Create appointment (3-step wizard)
- Public booking end-to-end
- Complete consent signing
- Accept invite
- Mobile signup (375 viewport)
- Mobile dashboard (375)
- Calendar keyboard nav
- Client profile load
- Payroll run read-only
- Admin dashboard load
- Theme toggle
- /dev/design renders
- 404 page

### 7. Lighthouse CI config
`lighthouserc.json` with budget: performance/a11y/best-practices/seo all ≥95.

### 8. Launch runbook (`docs/RUNBOOK.md`)
- SEV1/2/3 definitions
- Railway rollback steps (UI: Deployments → Redeploy previous)
- Status page URL
- On-call (Yash solo for launch month)
- Post-mortem template

### 9. Acceptance gate
```bash
rm -rf .next && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint --max-warnings=0 && pnpm build
pnpm dlx @axe-core/cli http://localhost:3100 --tags wcag21aa
pnpm dlx lighthouse {route} --only-categories=performance,accessibility,best-practices,seo
pnpm playwright test
```

All must pass.

Keep spec under 800 words total. Files, commands, concrete checks. No lengthy prose. Koda builds from this.

A11y Certification Benchmark 9 10 **Who publicly claims WCAG 2.1 AA:** 11 - **Stripe** — publishes VPATs/ACRs on request (enterprise compliance track); Stripe Dashboard conforms to WCAG 2.1 AA per their accessibility page. Uses axe-core in CI. 12 - **GitHub** — maintains a public accessibility statement; claims WCAG 2.1 AA conformance for github.com; runs `axe-core` + manual audits with Deque. 13 - **Linear** — no public VPAT but ships keyboard-first UX; treats a11y as a product principle rather than compliance theater. Public commits reference aria-live toasts + focus rings. 14 - **Notion** — claims "working toward WCAG 2.1 AA" (partial conformance); known gaps in drag-and-drop; publishes an accessibility statement. 15 16 **Audit stack (industry standard):** 17 1. **Automated** — `axe-core` via `@axe-core/playwright`, Lighthouse a11y score ≥ 95, `eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y` in CI. 18 2. **Manual** — keyboard-only walkthrough of top 10 flows, screen reader (NVDA + VoiceOver) spot checks on critical paths. 19 3. **Third-party** — Deque, Level Access, or TPGi full audit for VPAT. Cost: $5K–$25K. Defer until enterprise deals demand it. 20 4. **Continuous** — axe in CI blocks merges on new violations. Pa11y CI for regression. 21 22 **Critical techniques (cited from W3C + WAI):** 23 - **Form errors:** `aria-describedby` referencing error-text ID **before** helper-text ID, combined with `aria-invalid="true"` on the invalid input. Move focus to first error on submit. [ARIA19/W3C] 24 - **Live regions:** Empty container in DOM on page load with `aria-live="polite"` + `aria-atomic="true"`; inject error text into it. Toasts use `role="status"` (polite) for success, `role="alert"` (assertive) for failures. 25 - **Focus management:** Trap focus in modals (Radix/shadcn handles this); restore focus to the trigger on close; visible focus ring (2px, WCAG 2.4.7 requirement in 2.1 AA). 26 - **Landmarks:** `

Performance Benchmark (Top SaaS Dashboards) 37 38 | Product | Authenticated dashboard LCP (p75, desktop) | Technique | 39 |---|---|---| 40 | **Linear** | ~0.8–1.2s | Local-first cache (IndexedDB), instant paint from cache, sync in background. React SPA, minimal server roundtrips post-auth. | 41 | **Stripe Dashboard** | ~1.8–2.4s | Heavy JS (~1.2MB gzip). Optimizes via aggressive route-level code splitting, service worker caching, and CDN-edged payloads. Uses React.lazy + Suspense extensively. | 42 | **Vercel Dashboard** | ~1.1–1.6s (doubled speed per their public post) | Migrated to RSC + Suspense + `loading.tsx` streaming. Lazy-loaded heavy components. Parallelized data fetches with Promise.all + cache hints. | 43 | **Notion** | ~2.8–4.5s (heaviest) | Collaborative editor is expensive. Uses `` for fonts + fallback system stack. Route-level code splitting. CRDT sync runs off main thread. | 44 45 **Techniques to adopt in InkOS:** 46 1. **RSC streaming** — every `app/(app)/*/page.tsx` keeps async data fetches at the server level; wrap client chart/table components in `` with skeleton fallbacks. Use `loading.tsx` per route segment. 47 2. **Image optimization** — `next/image` with `priority` only on above-fold (dashboard hero KPI), `loading="lazy"` elsewhere. Supabase Storage with image transformations for client photos. 48 3. **Code split** — dynamic import heavy charts (`Recharts`), PDF generation, consent signature canvas: `dynamic(() => import('./Chart'), { ssr: false, loading: () => })`. 49 4. **Preload** — `` to Supabase URL + Dodo checkout domain; `next/font` for Geist (auto-preloads with `display: swap`). 50 5. **RSC payload** — keep client component boundaries narrow; avoid `"use client"` at page level. Audit payload in Chrome DevTools Network tab. 51 52 **Sources:** 53 - [How we made the Vercel Dashboard twice as fast](https://vercel.com/blog/how-we-made-the-vercel-dashboard-twice-as-fast) 54 - [Optimizing RSC payload size (Vercel KB)](https://vercel.com/kb/guide/how-to-optimize-rsc-payload-size) 55 - [Architecting Stripe's Black Friday site](https://vercel.com/blog/architecting-reliability-stripes-black-friday-site) 56 57 --- 58 59 ## 3. Lab numbers (Lighthouse) are a sanity check, not the gate. 73 74 **Sources:** 75 - [Core Web Vitals Explained 2026 (RoastWeb)](https://roastweb.com/blog/core-web-vitals-explained-2026) 76 - [Web Vitals (web.dev)](https://web.dev/articles/vitals) 77 78 --- 79 80 ## 4. Never include app/admin routes. 108 109 --- 110 111 ## 5. Error Tracking + Monitoring 112 113 **Sentry for Next.js 16 (production config):** 114 1. **Source maps** — use `@sentry/nextjs` with `withSentryConfig()` in `next.config.ts`; sourcemaps upload via `sentry-cli` on CI build. Set `hideSourceMaps: true` so they're not publicly served but still symbolicate. 115 2. **Release tagging** — inject git SHA: `release: process.env.VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA || process.env.RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA`. Match `dist` between upload + SDK init. 116 3. **PII scrubbing** — `beforeSend(event) { delete event.user?.email; delete event.request?.cookies; return event; }`. Also enable Sentry's **Data Scrubber** server-side (UI toggle) + add `$string` rules for `password`, `token`, `authorization`, `ssn`, `ein`. 117 4. **URL parameterization** — configure `nextRouterInstrumentation` so `/clients/uuid-1234/edit` becomes `/clients/[id]/edit` in Sentry transactions. 118 5. **Sample rates** — `tracesSampleRate: 0.1` prod, `1.0` dev. `replaysSessionSampleRate: 0.01`, `replaysOnErrorSampleRate: 1.0`. 119 120 **Uptime + RUM:** 121 - **Better Stack** (recommended) — $24/mo for 10 monitors + on-call + status page in one. Alerts via SMS/phone for Yash solo on-call. 122 - **Alternative:** UptimeRobot free tier (50 monitors, 5-min interval) for pre-revenue launches. 123 - **RUM / Web Vitals in production:** PostHog's web perf module (we already have PostHog). Or Sentry Performance with `browserTracingIntegration()`. Ship `web-vitals` npm package → send LCP/INP/CLS to PostHog via `posthog.capture('web_vital', {...})`. 124 125 **Sources:** 126 - [Sentry source maps for Next.js](https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/javascript/guides/nextjs/sourcemaps/) 127 - [Scrubbing sensitive data (Sentry)](https://docs.sentry.dev/platforms/javascript/guides/nextjs/data-management/sensitive-data/) 128 - [Better Stack incident management](https://betterstack.com/incident-management) 129 130 --- 131 132 ## 6. Playwright Smoke Test Suite 133 134 **Industry norm:** 10–20 smoke tests, run in < 5 minutes against a production build. Focus on paid-feature paths that, if broken, stop revenue. 135 136 **Recommended InkOS suite (~15 tests):** 137 1. Signup → email verify → onboarding completes → lands on `/dashboard` 138 2. Login existing user → dashboard loads 139 3. Password reset flow (request link, not email consumption) 140 4. Studio owner invites artist → invite URL works 141 5. Consent form send → `/consent/[token]` loads → signature saves 145 9. Inventory create item → stocktake page renders 146 10. Dodo checkout redirect works (mock webhook, verify DB state) 147 11. Payroll run → commission calculated for paid booking 148 12. Reports revenue page loads + CSV export downloads 149 13. Admin login + impersonate studio → exits impersonation cleanly 150 14. REACH ink registry create → expiry alert renders 151 15. Rate-limited endpoint returns 429 after N requests 152 153 **Config pattern:** 154 - Two Playwright projects: `smoke` (critical, no retries, runs on every PR + post-deploy) and `full` (retries ×2, runs nightly). 155 - Sign in **programmatically via Supabase API** in test setup — only one test walks the UI login. Saves ~30s per test. 156 - CI with 1 worker for Supabase FK-heavy paths; 4 workers for read-only tests. 157 - Run against `pnpm start` (production build), never `pnpm dev`. 158 159 **Sources:** 160 - [Smoke testing your SaaS with Playwright (Makerkit)](https://makerkit.dev/blog/tutorials/smoke-testing-saas-playwright) 161 - [Next.js Playwright testing guide](https://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/testing/playwright) 162 163 --- 164 165 ## 7. Launch Runbooks 166 167 **Incident response (severity ladder):** 168 - **SEV1** — site down, payments broken, data loss risk → page Yash within 5min, Slack + SMS + phone. 169 - **SEV2** — degraded perf, non-critical feature broken → Slack alert, fix within 4h. 170 - **SEV3** — cosmetic/non-blocking → create issue, weekly triage. 171 172 **Rollback procedure (Railway):** 173 - Every deploy auto-tags on Railway with commit SHA. Rollback = Railway dashboard → Deployments → select prior → "Redeploy". < 2min. 174 - **DB migrations are forward-only** — never roll back a migration. Wrap risky changes in expand/contract pattern (add column nullable → backfill → flip code → drop old column in next release). 175 176 **On-call (Yash solo for v1):** 177 - Better Stack on-call with single rotation = Yash 24/7 for launch month. 178 - Escalation policy: 5min phone call → 10min SMS → 15min email. 179 - Post-launch week 4: evaluate whether to onboard 2nd on-call (contractor) at $500/mo retainer. 180 181 **Status page:** 182 - **Better Stack status page** (bundled free with their plan) — status.inkos.app via CNAME. Auto-publishes from uptime monitors. 183 - **Alternative:** Upptime (GitHub-hosted, free, dev-DIY) for pre-revenue. 184 - **Not recommended for v1:** Statuspage.io ($29+/mo, overkill for solo founder). 185 186 **Launch-day checklist:** 187 - All Sentry releases tagged + source maps verified 188 - Smoke suite green on production URL 189 - Rate limits tuned (not hit in normal traffic) 190 - Dodo webhook signing verified with test event 191 - Backups: Supabase PITR on, daily snapshot confirmed 192 - Robots.txt + sitemap live, OG images render (debug via [opengraph.xyz](https://www.opengraph.xyz)) 193 194 --- 195 196 ## 8.
